mapper.sql: a.id AS alert_id, a.driver_id, a.vehicle_id, a.sms_status AS status, d.out_id, d.recipient, d.attempted_at, d.provider_message_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sms_delivery d JOIN alert_record a ON a.id = d.alert_id WHERE a.sms_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY d.alert_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM sms_delivery d JOIN alert_record a ON a.id = d.alert_id WHERE d.next_check_at <= #{now} AND a.sms_status IN ('SENDING', 'SENT', 'SEND_UNKNOWN') ORDER BY d.next_check_at, d.alert_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_delivery d JOIN alert_record a ON a.id = d.alert_id SET a.sms_status = 'SKIPPED_REVOKED' WHERE d.alert_id = #{id} AND a.sms_status = 'PENDING' AND a.status = 'REVOKED'

UPDATE sms_delivery d JOIN alert_record a ON a.id = d.alert_id SET a.sms_status = 'SENDING', d.recipient = #{recipient}, d.attempted_at = #{now}, d.next_check_at = #{nextCheckAt} WHERE d.alert_id = #{id} AND a.sms_status = 'PENDING' AND a.status <> 'REVOKED'

UPDATE sms_delivery d JOIN alert_record a ON a.id = d.alert_id SET a.sms_status = #{status}, d.provider_message_id = COALESCE(#{providerMessageId}, d.provider_message_id), d.provider_code = #{providerCode}, d.next_check_at = #{nextCheckAt}, d.recipient = CASE WHEN #{nextCheckAt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE d.recipient END WHERE d.alert_id = #{id} AND a.sms_status = #{expected}
